items.title: Football Falls at Kennesaw State
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – The University of Delaware football team was in position to tie the game with a two-point conversion attempt late in the fourth quarter, but ultimately fell to Kennesaw State, 42-40, on Saturday evening at Fifth Third Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens drop to 4-5, 2-3 CUSA, while the Owls rise to 3-6 2-3 CUSA.

items.title: Football Looks to Continue Winning Ways at Kennesaw State
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will head to Kennesaw, Ga. to face the Kennesaw State Owls on Saturday, November 7 at 3 p.m. on ESPN+. This will be the first meeting between the two schools.

items.title: Minicucci Named CUSA Offensive Player of the Week, Moore Earns Freshman of the Week
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football took home a pair of Conference USA weekly awards after its performance against WKU, the league announced Monday. QB Nick Minicucci earned CUSA's Offensive Player of the Week award for the second-consecutive week, while S Kevin Moore was named the league's freshman of the week. It was the second time this season that Moore earned CUSA's rookie honor.

items.title: Minicucci Placed on Manning Award Stars of the Week List
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named one of the Manning Award Stars of the Week, the Allstate Sugar Bowl Committee announced Monday. Minicucci is the first player in program history to earn the weekly honor after making the Manning Award Watchlist earlier this year.

items.title: Minicucci Lands on Davey O’Brien Great 8 for Second-Consecutive Week
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Delaware football QB Nick Minicucci has been named to the Davey O'Brien Great 8 for Week 9, marking his second-consecutive week on the list, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced Monday. By making the Great 8, Minicucci qualified for the Davey O'Brien Award Midseason Watchlist. items.title: Minicucci Sets UD Records for Consecutive Completions and Consecutive Completions to Start Game as Football Defeats WKU, 35-21
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – QB Nick Minicucci set the program record for consecutive completions and consecutive completions to begin a game (18) as the University of Delaware football team downed Western Kentucky, 35-21, on Tuesday night at Houchens-Smith Stadium. The Fightin' Blue Hens have now won two-straight games, improving to 4-4, 2-2 CUSA, while the Hilltoppers drop to 3-5, 2-2 CUSA.

items.title: Football Takes Home Three Weekly CUSA Awards
items.summary: DALLAS – University of Delaware football took home three Conference USA weekly awards for its efforts against Missouri State, the league announced Monday. QB Nick Minicucci earned CUSA's Offensive Player of the Week award, LB Jawarren Corbin was named the league's defensive player of the week, and OL Steven Demboski won the CUSA Offensive Lineman of the Week award. items.title: Football Wraps Weekday CUSA Play at WKU
items.summary: NEWARK, Del. – The University of Delaware football team will head to Bowling Green, Ky. to face the WKU Hilltoppers on Tuesday, October 27 at 7 p.m. for a Weekday CUSA matchup on CBS Sports Network. This will be the fourth matchup all-time between the two programs as the Fightin' Blue Hens hold a 2-1 record against the Hilltoppers.
